sources.title: UKHSA — National flu and COVID-19 surveillance report, 29 Oct

medicine-shortages.summary: US chemotherapy drug shortages persist after Pfizer plant flooding
medicine-shortages.state: Cytarabine and irinotecan injections remain on US shortage lists, partly linked to flooding at a Pfizer plant in India expected to disrupt supply into 2028 (FDA). The FDA's daily list shows dozens of current shortages, mainly sterile injectables. No new national rationing or UK Serious Shortage Protocol had been reported as of 4 Nov.
medicine-shortages.for_you: Patients concerned about supply should speak to their pharmacist or prescriber; do not stockpile.
medicine-shortages.rubric_hit: Essential medicine shortage in a major system = Watch; no widespread rationing

sources.title: FDA — Drug shortages database

exploited-vulns.summary: Five new CISA known-exploited vulnerabilities in a week
exploited-vulns.state: CISA added five vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue in the seven days to 3 Nov and 33 in 30 days, under the 11-a-week Watch line. Recent additions include WordPress Core (3 Nov) and two Ivanti Connect Secure flaws (30 Oct).
exploited-vulns.for_you: Install software updates promptly, especially for WordPress sites and VPN gateways.
exploited-vulns.rubric_hit: KEV additions 7d 6 below the 11 Watch line

sources.title: CISA — Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue

aid-funding.summary: Humanitarian appeals badly underfunded; WFP cut Gaza food aid for 500,000
aid-funding.state: WHO's Sudan health appeal was only 23% funded as of mid-October (WHO, 12 Oct), and WFP cut monthly food aid in Gaza from 1.6 million to 1.1 million people from late October after receiving less than half its usual funding. UNHCR's winter appeal warns resources are dwindling. No new pipeline break was reported as of 4 Nov.
aid-funding.for_you: Aid agencies' appeals are the main route for public support.
aid-funding.rubric_hit: Major ration cuts announced = Watch; no famine-country pipeline break

sources.title: WHO — IPC Sudan alert and appeal funding
UNHCR — Winter appeal as resources dwindle

uk-supply-margins.summary: NESO expects adequate electricity margins this winter; no notices issued
uk-supply-margins.state: NESO's winter outlook expects GB electricity margins to be the strongest in six years, though some analysts say its assumptions are optimistic (NESO; Watt-Logic, 27 Oct). National Gas reported supply capability well above 1-in-20 peak demand. No margin notices had been issued as of 4 Nov.
uk-supply-margins.for_you: No action needed. NESO and National Gas publish notices if margins tighten.
uk-supply-margins.rubric_hit: No NESO or National Gas notices = Normal

sources.title: NESO — Strongest winter electricity margins in six years
Watt-Logic — NESO winter outlook flattered by optimistic assumptions

uk-supply-margins.basis_detail: NESO and National Gas system notices

uk-floods.state: The Environment Agency had no severe flood warnings, flood warnings or flood alerts in force in England at 05:40 UTC on 4 Nov.
uk-floods.for_you: No action needed; sign up for Environment Agency flood warnings if you live in a flood-risk area.

sources.title: Environment Agency — Check for flooding

headline: The US–Iran war keeps Hormuz largely shut as Trump floats a 'heavy hit' on Iran, though Brent has slipped to about $95 on deal hopes. Russia struck power sites in nine Ukrainian regions on 4 Nov. Cyclone Murasu has dissipated.

situations.name: US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock
situations.summary: Trump said on 4 Nov a 'heavy hit' on Iran may be needed; IRGC claims tankers hit mines near Hormuz. Brent fell to about $95 on deal hopes.

situations.name: Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank
situations.summary: Russian strikes damaged power sites in nine Ukrainian regions overnight into 4 Nov; Russia said it downed 709 drones. Talks set for mid-November.

situations.name: Super El Niño
situations.summary: ONI rose to +2.5 for Aug–Oct: drought risk in East and southern Africa, record-range warmth and faster CO₂ growth.

situations.name: Ebola outbreak, DR Congo
situations.summary: Africa CDC counted 5,376 Ebola deaths among more than 10,000 cases to 2 Nov, mostly in DR Congo; a WHO emergency (PHEIC) since May.

situations.name: Sudan war
situations.summary: Drone strikes have cut parts of Sudan off the power grid; a strike on a South Kordofan fuel station killed 10 on 4 Nov.

situations.name: France: debt stress and protests
situations.summary: OAT–Bund spread near 160bp on 2 Nov; budget vote delayed and unions hold a general strike on 5 Nov.

situations.name: Energy shock feeding inflation
situations.summary: US CPI 4.0%; Australia hiked to 4.85% on 3 Nov and a Bank of England rise to 4% is expected on 5 Nov.

situations.name: Binance theft and North Korean escalation
situations.summary: FBI blames North Korea for a $6.3bn Binance theft; Pyongyang denied it and fired missiles on 4 Nov. Binance withdrawals are resuming.
